notes.title: Viewer mode added
notes.content:
Hello everyone, in order to improve the viewing experience of the viewers watching the live stream, we have specially added the viewer mode to the streamers. When this mode is enabled, the brightness of the game output on the screen will be greatly improved. The brightness of the game output in the Head Mounted Display is unchanged.
The method of opening is as follows:
1.	Right click on the PaperDolls in the steam library，Click Properties. As shown below:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663836/0208cb01017b4f3cd06fb42e7490b7d8e43b7734.jpg[/img]
2.	Click on the BETAS tab, Select Viewer Mode from the drop down menu. As shown below:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663836/bfb057c6e5336d3e0e4a8ff14b425f2855a3159c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dear Paper Doll players,
notes.content:
Thanks a million for your attention to Paper Dolls. 
The innovative movement method of the game is very important in the entire design system, in which irreplaceable significance cannot be told here. We are sure the skills that have learned earlier will be not only important to the coming part about escape, but also necessary for the Great Escape. 
Our game has a rank system actually, wish you all good luck and rank Golden S.
